overview_description.description:
Codat is the universal API for SaaS and financial service providers. The company provides real-time connectivity to enable software providers and financial institutions to build integrated products for their small business customers. Codat handles the heavy lifting of integrations, leaving providers free to focus on how integrations can improve their products for their small business customers.

Codat is backed by Tiger Global, PayPal Ventures, Index Ventures, and American Express Ventures.

about_short_description.short_description: Codat is a financial platform that builds integrated software for small business customers.

product.name: Codat Spend Insights
product.description: A platform enabling financial institutions to facilitate seamless data sharing and provide actionable spend insights for small and middle-market businesses.

product.name: Sync for Expenses
product.description: An API solution that automates the synchronization of expense data, receipts, and attachments between corporate card issuers or spend management platforms and accounting software.

product.name: Sync for Commerce
product.description: An integration API that enables point-of-sale and payment providers to embed native accounting integrations for merchants, facilitating revenue capture and reducing churn.

product.name: Bank Feeds API
product.description: A developer-friendly API that enables business banks and neo-banks to provide direct connectivity between bank accounts and customers' accounting or ERP platforms.

product.name: Accounting Automation Platform
product.description: An integration infrastructure platform that enables fintech providers to build and maintain accounting and ERP integrations, supporting payment workflows and financial data synchronization.

product.name: QuickBooks Desktop Connector
product.description: A connector that enables integration with QuickBooks Desktop and QuickBooks Online, supporting hosted environments and automatic updates for continuous data flow.
